line 1725 (outcome 'ok' term): the only other boot prep outcome is 'threw' (line 677), and restorePrepNeverThrows line 1778 rejects every such action in the combined gate, so no must-accept witness can hold a threw boot prep; with the term removed RPPE only changes its own solo verdict on histories restorePrepNeverThrows always rejects. Closed as combined-gate equivalent (runner cannot prove REDUNDANT for a stricter clause); Opus step-4 check should confirm.

line 1728 (carryOfJob): a carry with !carryOfJob(prev) is a state restoreJobMatchesReality rejects at every step of every trace: no job -> line 2202 (carry with no restore job), job id differs -> line 2208 (carry belongs to another job). line 1754 (departed, 1st term): a key k in c.keptKeys that is absent from next.local.keptKeys is rejected by line 1765 (next.local.keptKeys[k] !== c.keptKeys[k]) with the same invariant, and one present in next.local.keptKeys is in locallyReferencedKeys (line 776 adds every keptKeys key) so line 1757 never reaches departed(); the term can never change the verdict. Not provable as REDUNDANT by the runner: it needs a witness of a DIFFERENT predicate that this predicate also rejects, and none exists (scan of all must-reject witnesses).

line 1754 (departed, 3rd term): line 1757 only consults departed(k) when !keys.has(k), and keys includes every key of next.local.keptKeys (locallyReferencedKeys line 776), so k in next.local.keptKeys already means keys.has(k) is true and the term is never evaluated to a verdict.
